basic_details.job_title: PM SHRI KV Nangal Bhur TGT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, Nangal Bhur, an autonomous body under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, is preparing a panel of Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT) in Mathematics and Sanskrit for session 2026-27, purely on a contractual basis. Eligible and interested candidates must apply online only through the Samvida Sathi portal between 26 November 2026 and 2 December 2026, and the interview for both posts is on 3 December 2026, with reporting at 10:00 AM in the Vidyalaya premises.

how_to_apply: The application is online only. The notice gives these steps:
Apply online only through the Samvida Sathi portal (samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in).
Submit the online application between 26.11.2026 and 02.12.2026.
Report for the interview on 03.12.2026 at 10:00 AM in the Vidyalaya premises at VPO Nangal Bhur, Ghiyala Road, Distt Pathankot, Punjab 145101.
The notice does not list the documents to upload or bring. It says detailed information is available on the school website.

content_sections.heading: About PM SHRI KV Nangal Bhur
content_sections.text: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, Nangal Bhur is a CBSE-affiliated school (CBSE Affiliation No. 1600025, School code 24543) that describes itself as an autonomous body under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The school is located at VPO Nangal Bhur, Ghiyala Road, Distt Pathankot, Punjab 145101. This recruitment is to build a panel of teachers for the 2026-27 session.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists two posts for the panel. It does not print the number of vacancies for either post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites "eligible and interested candidates" for both posts. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, experience or age limit for TGT (Mathematics) or TGT (Sanskrit). The notice states that detailed information is available on the school website, nangalbhur.kvs.ac.in. Candidates should check the official notification and the school website for the subject-specific eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PM SHRI KV Nangal Bhur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The application is online only. The notice gives these steps: Apply online only through the Samvida Sathi portal (samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in). Submit the online application between 26.11.2026 and 02.12.2026. Report for the interview on 03.12.2026 at 10:00 AM in the Vidyalaya premises at VPO Nangal Bhur, Ghiyala Road, Distt Pathankot, Punjab 145101. The notice does not list the documents to upload or bring. It says detailed information is available on the school website.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the panel is through an interview. The interview for both TGT (Mathematics) and TGT (Sanskrit) will be held on 3 December 2026 in the Vidyalaya premises. Candidates must report at 10:00 AM. Although the notice is titled "Walk in Interview", it asks candidates to apply online on the Samvida Sathi portal first, by 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. Which posts are included in PM SHRI KV Nangal Bhur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The panel is for Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – Mathematics and Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – Sanskrit for session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications are accepted from 26 November 2026 to 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online only through the Samvida Sathi portal (samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in).

faq.question: Q4. When is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview for both TGT (Mathematics) and TGT (Sanskrit) is on 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the reporting time and venue for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at 10:00 AM in the Vidyalaya premises of PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, Nangal Bhur, Ghiyala Road, Distt Pathankot, Punjab.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection for the panel is through an interview on 3 December 2026, after the online application on the Samvida Sathi portal.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis for session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q8. Can I just walk in on the interview day without applying?
faq.answer: The notice asks candidates to apply online through the Samvida Sathi portal between 26 November and 2 December 2026, before the interview on 3 December 2026.
